ctas.label: Let's run your terminal from one screen

sections.title: Software that watches, decides and records, everywhere at once
sections.text: A fuel terminal stores and moves petroleum products around the clock. Terminal automation replaces manual gauging, paper dockets and radio calls with one system that monitors every tank, meter and valve in real time, and keeps the record automatically.

items.title: Safety
items.text: Fire and gas detection and emergency shutdown, wired into the same system that runs the loading.

items.title: Accuracy
items.text: Every litre metered, reconciled and posted. The quantity that loaded is the quantity that billed.

items.title: Uptime
items.text: Predictive diagnostics flag a failing pump or valve before it stops a bay.

items.title: Compliance
items.text: Every action, alarm and shipment logged automatically. The audit trail writes itself.

sections.title: One system, not several
sections.text: Gauges, PLCs, safety system, barrier gates, fire panels, pumps and the SAP link all sit on a redundant dual-LAN backbone. The safety PLC runs separately from process control and reports its own health on a live diagnostic screen. The home screen is a launchpad: every part of the terminal is one click away.

posts.summary: Four fields, in this order: entity, scope, validity, accreditation.

body.title: Put this in your tender
items: Certificates must be issued in the name of the legal entity performing the work, not a parent or affiliate.
The certified scope must explicitly cover design, installation and commissioning of the works tendered.
Certificates must be valid on the date of bid submission and for the contract duration.
The certification body must be accredited by an IAF member; state the accreditation number.

posts.title: What a good control system specification contains
posts.summary: Architecture, I/O, safety, interfaces, security, lifecycle.
posts.author: [TBC]

image.alt: Gas compressor package with cooler at Titas LOC-E

body.title: Put this in your tender
items: The SIS shall be physically and functionally independent of the BPCS, per IEC 61511.
State the target SIL for each safety instrumented function, with verification calculations at FAT.
All process data shall be exposed over OPC UA or Modbus TCP without licence restriction.
Declare spare I/O capacity of not less than 20% per cabinet, wired to terminals.
State the declared product support horizon and the migration path at end of life.
Design shall target IEC 62443 Security Level 2 as a minimum.

posts.title: Six lines for a valve requirement
posts.summary: How to specify the cheapest component so it never stops the plant.
posts.author: [TBC]

body.title: Put this in your tender
items: State service condition and Cv per tag, not just size and class.
Distinguish isolation duty from control duty in the valve schedule.
State the fail position per tag, traceable to the HAZOP.
Require API 607 or API 6FA fire-safe certification where hydrocarbons are present.
Require ISO 15848-1 fugitive emission class for all stem-sealed valves.
Require API 598 test certificates for each valve, by serial number.
